description: "Horace Chase" by Constance Fenimore Woolson is a novel written in the late 19th century. Set in a North Carolina mountain village during the early 1870s, the story introduces the Franklin family, particularly focusing on the lively and somewhat whimsical character of Ruth Franklin.
